Our attention has turned to the planet Sekhur-5, once revered by the Ouroboros Corporation, a group we suspect may have discovered avenues out of this universe. Here, we have successfully traced the invaluable Antimatter Fuel required to activate the Ouroboros Ship Traversal Device.
Ouroboros Orbs are accumulated by Buying Loop Mods and letting Time Pass.

Recently, our soldiers have begun relaying reports concerning subterranean activities that are causing notable disturbances in the upper layers of the planet's surface. These developments suggest that the enigmatic Ouroboros Corporation, in their wake, have implemented protective measures to safeguard their closely-held secrets.

The distinctive sediment and environmental makeup of this planet are truly exceptional. It's evident why the Ouroboros Corporation opted to establish a presence here. In this specific universe, this planet appears to provide nearly everything one could desire.

The one aspect that slightly tempers our pride is the realization that we are, in essence, retracing the footsteps of the Ouroboros Corporation, who embarked on this path before us. It raises intriguing questions about whether we might encounter them beyond the confines of this universe.
